description: This file defines an abstract class 'Pdf' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for handling PDF output. It manages properties such as font, paper size, orientation, temporary directory setup, and provides methods for configuring these parameters and preparing files for saving, building upon a base 'Html' writer class.

classes.name: Pdf
classes.description: An abstract class for PDF writing in PHPSpreadsheet, handling configuration of font, page setup, and file saving procedures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Pdf object with a Spreadsheet, sets up temporary directory, and marks as PDF output.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the font for PDF output, supports fonts like 'arialunicid0-japanese', 'arialunicid0-korean', etc.

methods.name: getPaperSize
methods.description: Retrieves the current paper size setting.

methods.name: setPaperSize
methods.description: Sets the paper size using predefined constants from PageSetup.

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.description: Gets the current page orientation setting.

methods.name: setOrientation
methods.description: Sets the page orientation, typically 'portrait' or 'landscape'.

methods.name: getTempDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path used for temporary files.

methods.name: setTempDir
methods.description: Sets the temporary directory, throws exception if directory doesn't exist.

methods.name: prepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares the file handle for saving the PDF, opening the file for writing.

methods.name: restoreStateAfterSave
methods.description: Closes the file handle after saving is complete.
